steps.title: Create input CSV file
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that includes the header line and the columns: Sample Location, Qubits, Volume (ul) for ng: 70, Sample Destination. Populate each row with the well identifier, the Qubit measurement, the volume in µL to transfer, and the destination tube name. Example rows: A1,3.5,20.0,A1 and A2,15,4.7,A2.

steps.title: Transfer sample volumes
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, transfer the volume specified in the CSV (ranging from 2‑35 µL) from each well of the 96‑well PCR plate into a 2 mL snap tube (or the 1.5 mL snap‑cap tube(s) indicated by the protocol).

steps.title: Repeat for all wells
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer step for every well listed in the CSV until the entire plate has been processed, pooling all samples into the designated snap tube(s).
